about_short_description.short_description: Silna Health builds proactive tools that handle all prior authorizations, benefit checks and insurance monitoring upfront.

product.name: Care Readiness Platform
product.description: A platform that automates prior authorizations, benefit checks, and insurance monitoring to ensure patients are cleared for care and providers can focus on caregiving.

product.name: Prior Authorization Management
product.description: An AI-driven service that manages the entire prior authorization process from submission to follow-up, including expiration tracking and escalation handling.

product.name: Benefit Checks
product.description: A service that automatically verifies patient insurance benefits, including coverage, visit limits, and out-of-pocket costs, to provide accurate quotes upfront.

product.name: Insurance Monitoring
product.description: A service that continuously verifies patient insurance eligibility, detects new insurance plans, and flags coverage changes to prevent claim denials.
